_about: PROVISIONAL gold data for the CS-201 'Data Structures & Algorithms' course notes (10 pages). Machine-drafted 2026-10-12 by Claude Code from the extracted text; NOT human-reviewed. Kept outside git. anchors = exact phrases (normalised: lowercase, ** and _ removed, whitespace collapsed) that a supporting chunk must contain. The document itself contains 'Quiz Benchmark Questions' boxes; several ask about things the notes never explain -- those are used as unanswerable probes.
